card.name: Words just before "tolerated" in titration
card.fires_on: Small words like "is", "if", "and", "well" or "not" in dose-titration instructions, right where "tolerated" or "tolerability" is expected next. Also the start of "tolerability".

modes.label: If dose is tolerated
modes.description: The word "is" or "well" after "if this dose" or "if the infusion", before "tolerated".
modes.example: If this dose<< is>> tolerated, using standing systolic pressure measured

modes.label: Based on tolerability
modes.description: A linking word such as "and" or the start of "tolerability" in "based on efficacy and tolerability".
modes.example: Based on efficacy<< and>> tolerability, dosages may be increased

modes.label: Conditional before tolerated
modes.description: "if" or "Not" opening a clause about whether the dose is tolerated, then a step-up or reduction.
modes.example: If the starting dosage is:<< Not>> tolerated, reduce the dosage to 1

card.writes: It boosts "tolerated", "tolerate", "tolerance" and similar words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when a dosing instruction is about to say whether the patient tolerates the dose.
